a.xlink:title: Primary template; only the function-signature specializations below are defined.
Non-owning callable reference for a Ret(Args...) const signature; the target is invoked as const.
Non-owning callable reference for a Ret(Args...) const noexcept signature.
Non-owning callable reference for a Ret(Args...) noexcept signature; the target must not throw.
Non-owning callable reference for a Ret(Args...) signature; the target is invoked as non-const.
